activation.normal_mode: P1428_MUTANT absent; no mutation hook active
activation.base_command: env P1428_MUTANT=<ID> cargo test -q -p typst-infra --test p1428_math_frac <TEST> -- --exact --nocapture

unknown_policy: Unknown is fail-closed, never satisfies a mandatory case, never kills a mutation and contributes zero score.

mutations.name: compare_raw_html
mutations.operator: Use raw serialized HTML instead of decoded text nodes.
mutations.expected_witness: raw output contains " and lacks the literal quoted style fragment

mutations.name: unsafe_sequential_entity_decoding
mutations.operator: Apply a second ordered global entity-replacement pass.
mutations.expected_witness: &quot; becomes a quote instead of literal "

mutations.name: accept_missing_markup
mutations.operator: Accept plain text as attributable HTML.
mutations.expected_witness: plain text becomes Ok instead of Unknown(HtmlMarkup)

mutations.name: reuse_empty_svg
mutations.operator: Observe SVG and default its indistinguishable result to 00.
mutations.expected_witness: F10 is observed as 00 instead of 10

mutations.name: accept_multiple_carriers
mutations.operator: Select the first of multiple carriers.

mutations.name: swap_deparenthesization_bits
mutations.operator: Swap numerator and denominator bits after carrier extraction.

mutations.name: infer_bits_from_source
mutations.operator: Infer bits from main source spelling after validating carrier cardinality.
mutations.expected_witness: identical main source #include case.typ yields inferred 00 while included carrier is 11

mutations.name: drop_layout_conjunct
mutations.operator: Return the bit classification without conjoining layout.
mutations.expected_witness: Preserved bits plus Unknown layout is incorrectly Preserved

mutations.name: drop_preserved_control
mutations.operator: Remove the diagnostic-control bit from the required C01-C04 mask.

mutations.name: credit_unknown
mutations.operator: Grant one mutation-credit unit to Unknown.
mutations.expected_witness: U01 and U06 Unknown receive aggregate credit 2 instead of 0

claim_boundary: Executable test-observer mutations only. This artifact does not alter production, seal inputs, classify general parity, attest isolation or emit a final verdict.
